description: Earth worlds only: keeps Floral Zones plants in their home floristic regions. The species-to-realm tables are the packs' own (their config/biomes.json, copied verbatim); this mod supplies the missing half, a position-to-realm map drawn on the real Earth (generous lat/lon boxes), and filters tree, shrub and blockpatch generation with it. Inert in any world whose config does not set earthWorldgen=true. If its tree-generation hook cannot be applied it disables that half with a loud log line rather than failing silently. Config: ModConfig/earthflora.json. STAGED BUILD for review; see earth-realms/REPORT.md.
name: Earth Flora Realms
